requests.reason: Establish protocol selection, constructor arguments and master registration before attributing configuration or fault assumptions to the Paxos implementation.
Inspect instance state, leader bookkeeping, initialization, persistence helpers and the authority-entry interface. Identify candidate facts spanning A1, A2 and A6 without assuming their guarantees.
Inspect registration and participant/leader discovery to establish the A4 configuration boundary and its relationship to A2. Do not infer static membership from constructor signatures alone.
Complete the cached constructor and inspect concrete storage initialization, execution settings and quorum-size interfaces that may govern protocol behavior and restart assumptions.
Inspect prepare, accept and both commit consumers for contextual checks, retained command representations and persistence handoffs across A1, A2, A3 and A6.
Inspect how replies establish support, select values and advance decisions, including any client-completion effects. Recover actual progress ownership before proposing obligations.

Inspect the named recovery path and decision execution loop for A3/A5/A7 handoffs, missing-instance handling, execution ordering and reply timing. A recovery function name does not establish restart support.
Inspect disconnect/reconnect, proposal routing, operation identity allocation and reply retrieval to recover the caller side of A7 and identify retry or completion semantics requiring follow-up.

rationale: Prioritize deployment applicability and distinct responsibility boundaries before deeper investigation. These eight nonoverlapping ranges request 942 uncached lines and avoid all supplied cached intervals. A provisional estimate of 47000 unique characters fits the 66127-character breadth allowance; exact normalized character cost requires framework preflight, with lower-priority ranges deferred if necessary. The README supplies descriptive claims, while the requested implementation ranges can establish observed behavior, not normative correctness.
gap: Applicability and behavioral understanding across A1–A7 remain incomplete. Missing evidence includes the protocol event loop and proposal/broadcast producers, master authority-transition loop, message identity fields, transport failure handling, configuration parsing, concrete state execution, buffered client completion and any durable replay path. Fault and restart contracts are not established by the supplied documentation. The referenced guide.md, activity-classes.md and behavior-facts.md were not supplied. No obligation, defect, calibration or correctness conclusion is established by this reading plan.
